input_output_options.title: Global options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It must be a comma-separated file with a header row and may include an optional 'msa' column for ColabFold A3M inputs. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/proteinfold/usage#samplesheet-input).
input.errorMessage: Input samplesheet must be a CSV file that exists. Please check the file path and format.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.
outdir.errorMessage: Output directory path must be specified

mode.description: Specifies the prediction backend mode (the default is opendde because the AlphaFold3 weights carry usage restrictions); provide a comma-delimited list to run several backends over the same MSA inputs (e.g. "alphafold3,alphafold2"). Each mode publishes under its own results subdirectory. ColabFold2 backends are named after the tool they run. alphafold2 runs the AlphaFold2 models through the ColabFold2 module; colabfold_batch picks alphafold2_ptm for monomers and alphafold2_multimer_v3 for complexes, and the AlphaFold2 backends only fold samples whose input has a reusable protein MSA. Use --esmfold2_model to select the ESMFold2 variant.

msa_tool.description: MSA generation module used to produce the input MSAs for structure prediction. One of colabfold_search (local MMseqs2 ColabFold search), alphafold2_msa (AlphaFold2 jackhmmer data pipeline, incl. species pairing), alphafold3_msa (AlphaFold3 data pipeline), or set --use_msa_server to use the ColabFold MSA server.

split_fasta.description: Split input multi-fasta file in separated fasta files each of them containing one sequence to be folded

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.
email.errorMessage: Please provide a valid email address

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.
multiqc_title.errorMessage: MultiQC title must be less than or equal to 100 characters

db.description: The directory where reference data is stored. Individual methods can be overwritten with method-specific paths.

full_dbs.description: Global toggle for full database usage.

random_seed.description: Global random seed, forwarded to colabfold_batch (--random-seed) and honoured by every prediction backend: the AlphaFold2 backends seed the model runners, and the AlphaFold3-open backends set the folding input's rng_seeds.

msa_server_url.description: Specify your custom MMSeqs2 API server url
msa_server_url.errorMessage: Please provide a valid URL for the MMSeqs2 API server

write_modelcif.description: Assemble modelCIF (.mmcif/.bcif) deposits for every predicted structure (requires modelCIF-compatible outputs).
write_modelcif.help_text: Runs ASSEMBLE_MODELCIF and MODELCIF_VALIDATE per sample and model.

modelcif_binary.description: Write compressed binaryCIF (.bcif) instead of text mmCIF.

modelcif_pae_embed.description: Embed PAE matrices as local-pairwise QA metrics instead of linking as associated files.

modelcif_software_details.description: Optional YAML overriding the built-in software/protocol metadata used for ModelCIF population (e.g. template search attribution).

alphafold2_max_template_date.description: Maximum date of the PDB templates used by 'AlphaFold2' mode
alphafold2_max_template_date.errorMessage: Date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format

alphafold2_full_dbs.description: If true uses the full version of the BFD database otherwise, otherwise it uses its reduced version, small bfd

colabfold_num_recycles.errorMessage: Number of recycles must be a whole number between 1 and 20

msa_batch_size.description: Number of inputs processed together during MSA search; -1 runs all inputs in one batch
msa_batch_size.errorMessage: MSA batch size must be -1 or a positive integer

inference_batch_size.description: Number of inputs processed together during structure prediction; -1 runs all inputs in one batch.
inference_batch_size.errorMessage: Inference batch size must be -1 or a positive integer

report_batch_size.description: Number of samples processed together per report/ModelCIF task ; -1 runs all samples in one task
report_batch_size.errorMessage: Report batch size must be -1 or a positive integer

colabfold_db_load_mode.description: Specify the way that MMSeqs2 will load the required databases in memory
colabfold_db_load_mode.errorMessage: DB load mode must be 0, 1, 2, or 3

colabfold_create_index.description: Create databases indexes when running colabfold_local mode

analysis_batch_size.description: Number of samples processed together by the downstream analysis tasks (report generation, MultiQC content preparation); -1 runs all samples of a mode in one batch.

colabfold2_options.title: ColabFold2 preview options
colabfold2_options.description: Experimental multi-model predictors provided by the ColabFold AlphaFold3 preview. MSA generation is split from inference: it either runs offline via the MMseqs2 ColabFold search or uses the consented MSA server.

colabfold2_params_path.description: Path to the ColabFold2 model weights data dir. Defaults to a colabfold2_models directory inside the ColabFold search database root (--colabfold_db, itself derived from --db in colabfold2 modes)

colabfold2_weights_precision.description: Weights precision for the selected ColabFold2 backend. int8 selects the '-int8' weight variant upstream stages for backends that provide one.

colabfold2_kernel_backend.description: Fused-kernel implementation used by colabfold_batch. 'auto' is the upstream default (tokamax/Pallas on sm_80+); on GPUs missing from the bundled JAX/Pallas device table (e.g. L40S, V100) 'auto' fails with 'No supported GPU devices found' and 'cuda_legacy' enables the colabfold-kernels shim with legacy float16 kernels instead.

colabfold2_compile_cache.description: Persistent compiled-kernel cache directory, private to the user by default (it caches compiled executables that runs load and execute, so treat it as code and keep it out of group-writable locations); relative paths resolve against the launch directory. It survives between tasks and runs so JIT compilation is paid once per machine; it is bound into the inference containers automatically. Passed to colabfold_batch as --compile-cache (effective for the AlphaFold2 backends together with --use-fast-kernels, see --colabfold2_kernel_backend) and exported as JAX_COMPILATION_CACHE_DIR, which the AlphaFold3-family backends use for their per-bucket JIT compilation.

esmfold2_model.description: ESMFold2 model used by --mode esmfold2. msa uses the normal MSA model; lm300m and lm600m use the ESM-C language-model variants with --use-esm; confidence output depends on the upstream checkpoint and runtime version.

msa_cache_options.title: MSA cache options
msa_cache_options.description: Shared MMseqs MSA cache for ColabFold and Boltz.

use_msa_cache.description: Cache local MMseqs MSAs by default; set false to disable.

msa_cache_dir.description: Absolute local cache directory; overrides PROTEINFOLD_MSA_CACHE_DIR and the default <outdir>/msa_cache.

msa_cache_id.description: Optional database revision namespace; change when the database changes.

msa_cache_tool_id.description: Optional search-tool version or image digest namespace; change when the image changes.

process_skipping_options.title: Process skipping options
process_skipping_options.description: Options to skip various steps within the workflow.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.
max_multiqc_email_size.errorMessage: File size must be specified with units (KB, MB, GB, TB)

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

modules_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of nf-core module test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
